author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.90 shipped: v5.103.90: Bluetooth leads home/away (GPS assistive) + EV toggle alarm no longer pages
summary: v5.103.90: Bluetooth leads home/away (GPS assistive) + EV toggle alarm no longer pages
why: HA's person entity prefers the companion GPS tracker; on 10-24 Oji's phone re-sent a 14:03 home fix all day so URA and six direct readers held him home for 8+ hours while both his BLE trackers read not_home (13 segments, ~19 h in a week). Operator doctrine: BLE decides, GPS assists, missing GPS must not block away. Narrowest fix: one gate at the two person.state==home arms reusing the existing away arm, guarded by Bermuda's active proxy count so a dead fleet or a restart cannot mark everyone away. EV tripwire paged on routine evening behaviour at zero cost; operator wants no EV pages.
implications: Shipped PERSON-BLE-WINS-OVER-STALE-GPS-1, EV-TOGGLE-TRIPWIRE-PEAK-BOUNDARY-1 at v5.103.90; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.90.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: Presence: 24 h one-shot re-run of scripts/probes/presence_gps_override_probe.py — done if zero overnight app-user away stamps while own BLE reads home and no app-user away within 360-900 s after a restart; reopen if a home-without-phone false GUEST/AWAY is reported. EV: done if zero ev_toggle_tripwire notification rows over the next 7 days with anomaly rows still written.

refs.release_notes: Presence: a frozen companion-app GPS 'home' no longer holds an app user home when all their own BLE trackers read not_home and the Bermuda proxy fleet has been healthy (>=30 proxies) for 360 s; six trust readers use URA's view; switch BLE Leads Home/Away (default on) restores old behaviour. EV toggle tripwire keeps its anomaly row but no longer sends a notification. See docs/readmes/README_v5.103.90.md.
